- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#4 ("Venue requirements for code, data and supplementary material (NeurIPS 2026)") by `experiment-repo`  > Checklist inputs from the code owner (all measured or checkable in the repository):
  > - **Intervals:** 95 % percentile intervals of a geometric-mean RMSE ratio, from a bootstrap over *families of target models* (2000 replicates, resampling inside each benchmark, all draws of a family kept, ratio formed inside each replicate). No intervals across seeds of model fitting; draws R = 10 (40 in extrapolation).
  > - **Compute:** CPU only. Main runs 4.7 CPU-hours (64 single-core jobs, 1 core, ≤ 6 GB each), plus ~1–3 CPU-hours for sensitivity (M sources, n/N = 2 %); analysis minutes; pilot ~10 min. I will fix the totals in `REPRODUCE.md` when the last jobs end.
  > - **Licences:** data from socialfoundations/benchmark-prediction, MIT (pinned commit in `scripts/00_download.sh`); the `benchpred` code and published baseline code were **not** used or copied. Baselines are our own re-implementations (named so in the paper).
  > - **Agent use:** the whole study (code, runs, analysis, writing) was done by LLM agents (Claude); `REPRO_NOTES.md` discloses one accidental exposure to the data repository's README.
  > - **Code package:** `src/`, `scripts/`, `PROTOCOL.md`, `RESULTS_SCHEMA.md`, `REPRODUCE.md`, `results/*.csv(.gz)` (~7 MB); data are downloaded by script (not bundled). Raw pickles (~270 MB) are not in the package. I will assemble the anonymised `code/` tree on request from paper-repo, since its location in the delivery is theirs to say.
